destination.title: Supergravity compactifications, spectra and vacuum dynamics
destination.question: How do compactification geometry, sources and gaugings determine lower-dimensional theories, their vacua, spectra, deformations and stability?
destination.summary: No original prose scope is supplied, so the numerical membership is assessed as a proposed retrieval neighborhood. Its compactification and gauged-supergravity core is coherent, with methods and applications extending beyond AdS stability. Charged states, tensor-model chaos, confining gauge-theory walls and index-saddle admissibility remain separately identified neighboring questions.

systems: Classical gauged supergravities in several dimensions
String and M-theory compactifications and their consistent reductions
Associated holographic backgrounds and selected field-theory comparisons
targets: Consistent reductions, uplifts and low-energy completeness
KK spectra, interactions and holographic operator data
Perturbative stability, specified decay channels and domain walls
Continuous deformations, effective couplings and scale separation
regimes: Classical and linearized calculations, with separately identified loop questions
AdS, de Sitter and non-AdS settings where explicitly supplied
assumptions: Consistency of a finite truncation does not establish completeness of its light spectrum or higher-dimensional stability
Source localization, global geometry and flux conditions remain source-specific
Conjectures and historical claims are context or test targets
conventions: Boundary conditions, orientation, flux sign and spectral normalization remain attached to their source scopes
includes: The outside probes on ISO(7) stability, flux-source constraints and extended-supersymmetry AdS3 scale separation
Setting and representation facets as methodological access points
excludes: A universal stability or instability conclusion
Automatic identification of consistent truncations with complete effective theories
Automatic equivalence of questions sharing an overview card
Treating neighboring field-theory or saddle-selection questions as compactification-vacuum questions

sources.title: Beyond Twisted Tori

evidence.text: Can KK5 orientations and localized magnetic flux generate useful D-term interactions or supersymmetry breaking? How do the resulting source-inclusive compactifications fit into existing gauged-supergravity and generalized-geometry classifications?

sources.title: Type IIA AdS(4) compactifications on cosets, interpolations and domain walls

evidence.text: Which six-dimensional cosets with left-invariant strict SU(3) structures support supersymmetric type IIA AdS4 vacua, with or without smeared sources? Can these vacua be connected by supersymmetric domain walls or interpolated to a G2-holonomy lift?

sources.title: On the stability and spectrum of non-supersymmetric AdS(5) solutions of M-theory compactified on Kahler-Einstein spaces

evidence.text: Which nonsupersymmetric AdS5×M6 compactifications on positive Kähler-Einstein six-manifolds are stable against linearized bosonic supergravity perturbations, and what do their KK spectrum, M5 nucleation channel and neutral massless scalars imply for possible instabilities?

sources.title: Exploiting N=2 in consistent coset reductions of type IIA

evidence.text: Can left-invariant type IIA coset reductions be justified as consistent truncations, and can their four-dimensional N=2 structure constrain supersymmetric, nonsupersymmetric and de Sitter vacua, including perturbative string-loop effects?

sources.title: Universal Kaluza-Klein reductions of type IIB to N=4 supergravity in five dimensions

evidence.text: Can universal consistent type IIB reductions on arbitrary HK4 × S1 and SE5 retain the massive breathing-mode sector, and what five-dimensional supergravity, gauging and AdS vacua result?

sources.title: G-structures and Domain Walls in Heterotic Theories

evidence.text: Which internal SU(3)-structure six-manifolds support heterotic domain walls preserving two supercharges, and do domain walls in previously constructed four-dimensional half-flat mirror compactifications lift to the corresponding ten-dimensional solutions?

sources.title: New Supersymmetric and Stable, Non-Supersymmetric Phases in Supergravity and Holographic Field Theory

evidence.text: Can numerically discovered AdS critical points of four-dimensional maximal gauged supergravity be characterized analytically, connected by supersymmetric holographic flows, and tested for stability against the full scalar spectrum, including modes outside small truncations?

sources.title: Magnetic $AdS \times \mathbb R^2$: Supersymmetry and stability

evidence.text: Can a background Kaluza–Klein magnetic field produce a controlled lower-dimensional holographic IR theory, and which supersymmetric or nonsupersymmetric embeddings avoid magnetic, Coulomb-branch and other instabilities?

sources.title: Tri-Sasakian consistent reduction

evidence.text: Can eleven-dimensional supergravity on any seven-dimensional tri-Sasakian manifold admit a universal consistent truncation retaining massive modes, and what four-dimensional gauged supergravity, AdS vacua and subtruncations result?

sources.title: Spectrum and stability of compactifications on product manifolds

evidence.text: What is the complete linearized spectrum and perturbative stability of Freund–Rubin compactifications when a q-form individually wraps each of N internal Einstein factors, including factors with unequal flux densities?

sources.title: On new maximal supergravity and its BPS domain-walls

evidence.text: What are the scalar potential, fermion couplings and superpotentials of the SU(3)-invariant sector of dyonic SO(8) maximal supergravity, and what do they imply for nonsupersymmetric AdS stability and BPS domain walls?

sources.title: Uplifting non-compact gauged supergravities

evidence.text: How can known de Sitter vacua of regular noncompact maximal gauged supergravity be embedded into eleven-dimensional supergravity, including vacua requiring internal flux? The paper seeks a nonlinear metric and three-form ansatz and a generalized-geometric explanation for it.

sources.title: Towards Kaluza-Klein Dark Matter on Nilmanifolds

evidence.text: Determine the scalar Kaluza–Klein spectrum on the compact three-dimensional Heisenberg nilmanifold with general left-invariant metric, use it to assess a numerical spectral method, and construct an exploratory stable KK dark-matter candidate.

sources.title: Maximally Supersymmetric AdS Solutions and their Moduli Spaces

evidence.text: Which gaugings admit maximally supersymmetric AdS_D vacua for D≥4, and which continuous scalar deformations preserve their supersymmetry?

sources.title: Maximally Supersymmetric AdS Solutions in Gauged Supergravity

evidence.text: Which classical backgrounds preserve every supercharge of a gauged or otherwise deformed supergravity, which gaugings admit pure AdS vacua, and which continuous scalar deformations preserve their supersymmetry? The holographic motivation is to constrain conformal manifolds of dual SCFTs.

sources.title: Holographic RG flows in $N=4$ SCFTs from half-maximal gauged supergravity

evidence.text: Which supersymmetric AdS4 vacua, scalar spectra and domain-wall flows arise in semisimple, dyonically gauged N = 4 supergravity, and how might they describe relevant deformations of three-dimensional N = 4 SCFTs?

sources.title: AdS$_{8}$ solutions in type II supergravity

evidence.text: Can non-supersymmetric AdS8 compactifications provide string-theoretic evidence for unitary interacting seven-dimensional CFTs, beyond the dimensions admitting superconformal theories?

sources.title: Halving ISO(7) supergravity

evidence.text: Can half-maximal truncations make dyonic ISO(7) supergravity tractable while retaining its important supersymmetric vacua, and what additional gaugings and AdS extrema arise?

sources.title: A cornucopia of AdS$_{5}$ vacua

evidence.text: Which AdS5 critical points occur in five-dimensional maximal SO(6) gauged supergravity, what supersymmetry and scalar stability do they have, and how many can be captured by tractable consistent truncations?

sources.title: Bootstrap Bounds on Closed Einstein Manifolds

evidence.text: Can associativity and completeness of Laplacian eigenmodes constrain spectra and triple overlaps on closed Einstein manifolds, thereby bounding tree-level Kaluza–Klein masses and cubic interactions?

sources.title: Positive energy and non-SUSY flows in ISO(7) gauged supergravity

evidence.text: Can Hamilton–Jacobi methods establish positive-energy protection for non-supersymmetric AdS extrema within the G₂-invariant ISO(7) truncation, construct interpolating flat domain walls, and provide a method for curved flows?

sources.title: Compactifications of String/M-Theory and the Swampland

evidence.text: How can one vary the metric on S^7 without changing its topology? An SU(2) instanton twists an S^3 fiber over S^4; lambda scales the fiber contribution while the bundle remains S^7.

sources.title: Triality and the consistent reductions on AdS$_{3}$ × S$^{3}$

evidence.text: Can SO(4,4) triality generate inequivalent consistent sphere truncations of six-dimensional supergravity, exposing additional AdS3 vacua and their parameter-dependent Kaluza–Klein spectra?

sources.title: Comments on classical AdS flux vacua with scale separation

evidence.text: What structural conditions enforce integer AdS4 scalar dimensions, and do smooth G2 geometry and localized-source corrections change the AdS3 symmetry, spectrum or decay conclusions?

sources.title: Type IIB S-folds: flat deformations, holography and stability

evidence.text: How do flat deformations of type IIB S-folds encode marginal deformations holographically, change global geometry and supersymmetry, and affect stability when supersymmetry is fully broken?

sources.title: Searching for Coleman–de Luccia bubbles in AdS compactifications

evidence.text: Can Hamilton–Jacobi flows construct smooth, fully backreacted dS-sliced walls between supersymmetric and non-supersymmetric AdS vacua with string/M-theory uplifts, providing candidate Coleman–de Luccia bubbles beyond the thin-wall approximation?

sources.title: Nonsupersymmetric stable marginal deformations in <math display="inline"><mrow><msub><mrow><mi>AdS</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><mo>/</mo><msub><mrow><mi>CFT</mi></mrow><mn>2</mn></msub></mrow></math>

evidence.text: Can continuous supersymmetry-breaking deformations of AdS3 × S3 × T4 produce perturbatively stable heterotic and type II backgrounds and a candidate nonsupersymmetric two-dimensional holographic conformal manifold? What are their KK spectra, deformation operators and tested decay channels?

sources.title: Dimensionally reducing the classical Regge growth conjecture

evidence.text: How is the classical Regge growth conjecture realized by massive spin-2 Kaluza–Klein states after dimensional reduction of Einstein gravity, and what restrictions follow for their spectrum and couplings?

sources.title: Charting the conformal manifold of holographic CFT$_2$'s

evidence.text: Which continuous deformations of AdS3×S3×T4 and AdS3×S3×S3×S1 can be constructed uniformly in heterotic and type II supergravity, what are their Kaluza–Klein spectra and perturbative stability properties, and how should their worldsheet and holographic operators be interpreted?

sources.title: Squashed 7-spheres, octonions and the swampland

evidence.text: How do operator spectra on squashed S7 determine AdS4 masses and supersymmetry multiplets, and what do orientation reversal, boundary conditions and singletons imply for the nonsupersymmetric AdS stability question?

sources.title: Beyond Twisted Tori

evidence.text: Uplift the source system, retain its assumed geometrical Bianchi identity, and change the reduction circle. Map both curvature and signed sources to identify the resulting ten-dimensional RR identity and compare consistency conditions.

sources.title: Type IIA AdS(4) compactifications on cosets, interpolations and domain walls

evidence.text: For radial flows, solve gravitino and dilatino variations subject to a spinor projection. Supersymmetry expresses fluxes through A, ω and Φ and leaves one differential constraint; selected profiles are integrated using hypergeometric functions. Hitchin flow supplies the geometric G2-lift comparison.

sources.title: On the stability and spectrum of non-supersymmetric AdS(5) solutions of M-theory compactified on Kahler-Einstein spaces

evidence.text: For primitive transverse (1,1) eigenforms with λ>0, coupled metric/flux scalars have m±^2=λ+2c^2±√(16c^2λ+4c^4). The author applies the AdS5 scalar BF bound m^2≥−2c^2. At λ=0 the flux scalar is unphysical, leaving one scalar with m^2=4c^2.

sources.title: Exploiting N=2 in consistent coset reductions of type IIA

evidence.text: Apply the imported K-theory flux prescription [G]/(2π)=sqrt(A-hat(X)) ch(x), examining fractional quantization and whether cohomology classes admit K-theory lifts. The paper addresses selected lift questions rather than classifying all admissible fluxes.

sources.title: Universal Kaluza-Klein reductions of type IIB to N=4 supergravity in five dimensions

evidence.text: For SE5, identify the gauged generators from scalar covariant derivatives using the embedding-tensor framework. Analyze the scalar potential for AdS critical points and diagonalize fluctuations around the supersymmetric vacuum to extract masses.

sources.title: G-structures and Domain Walls in Heterotic Theories

evidence.text: Four-dimensional N=1 BPS equations are compared with expansions of the ten-dimensional flow. The reviewed superpotential prescription is W=√8∫Ω∧(Ĥ+i dJ); for the chosen mirror half-flat truncation with flux it gives W=√8(e_iT^i+ε_aZ^a+μ^aG_a), with projective Z^0=1 in this expression.

sources.title: Compactifications of String/M-Theory and the Swampland

evidence.text: Which internal geometry and units underlie the spectral branches? The calculation fixes Einstein squashing, Ricci curvature 27/10, and |m|=3/(2sqrt(5)) in dimensionless units, while retaining the flux sign for the later compactification.

sources.title: Kaluza-Klein spectrometry for ${\rm AdS_{3}}$ vacua

evidence.text: How can exceptional field theory compute bosonic Kaluza–Klein spectra around AdS3 vacua of three-dimensional half-maximal gauged supergravity, including vacua insufficiently constrained by residual supersymmetry?

sources.title: A Quantum Check of Non-Supersymmetric AdS/dCFT

evidence.text: Can a planar one-loop field-theory calculation reproduce the supergravity prediction for chiral-primary one-point functions in the flux-stabilized, completely non-supersymmetric D3-D7 AdS/dCFT setup?

sources.title: Chiral Supergravity

evidence.text: Can chiral gravity be extended supersymmetrically, with explicit gravitino modes and conserved charges demonstrating chirality and perturbative AdS3 stability under suitable boundary conditions?

sources.title: Consistent supersymmetric Kaluza-Klein truncations with massive modes

evidence.text: Can consistent supersymmetric Kaluza–Klein truncations retain the massive breathing-mode multiplet alongside the massless graviton multiplet, and can the resulting lower-dimensional theories generate exact higher-dimensional solutions?

sources.title: Nonsupersymmetric deformations of the dual of a confining gauge theory

evidence.text: Which small non-supersymmetric deformations of the Klebanov–Strassler confining background preserve its bosonic symmetries and regularity, and can a symmetry-preserving near-extremal branch develop a regular horizon?

sources.title: Applications of Holography

evidence.text: How do charged-gravity phases depend on scalar charge and boundary conditions; what spectral evidence of chaos appears in a finite tensor model; which asymptotically Klebanov-Strassler deformations break supersymmetry spontaneously?

sources.title: Anti-de Sitter vacua of gauged supergravities with eight supercharges

evidence.text: Can supersymmetric AdS extrema in Abelian gauged supergravity with eight supercharges and vector multiplets be connected by regular domain walls, and can these walls localize gravity?

sources.title: The spectrum of marginally-deformed $ \mathcal{N} $ = 2 CFTs with AdS$_{4}$ S-fold duals of type IIB

evidence.text: Determine the large-N operator spectrum across the N=2 conformal manifold of an N=4 three-dimensional S-fold CFT, and identify global properties of that manifold through its holographic KK spectrum.

sources.title: Marginally deformed AdS₅/CFT₄ and spindle-like orbifolds

evidence.text: Can deformations of Gaiotto–Maldacena AdS5 backgrounds preserve conformality while reducing or eliminating supersymmetry, and what do their singularities, charges and holographic observables imply for the dual CFTs?

sources.title: New formulations of D = 10 supersymmetry and D8 - O8 domain walls

evidence.text: Can Type II supergravity be formulated to support explicitly supersymmetric bulk-plus-brane source actions, particularly D8–O8 domain walls, and what do their sourced solutions imply for Romans mass quantization, wall separation and preserved supersymmetry?

sources.title: AdS$_9$ solutions in type II supergravities

evidence.text: Can type II supergravity support non-supersymmetric AdS9 geometries warped over an interval, and what do endpoint asymptotics, Euclidean actions and holographic observables imply about their possible quantum-gravity interpretation?

sources.title: Laplacian spectrum on a nilmanifold, truncations and effective theories

evidence.text: Which internal differential-form modes must a compactification retain to describe low-energy physics? The paper separates constructing a useful spectral basis from proving that a finite reduction captures every light fluctuation of an interacting background.

sources.title: The $ \mathcal{N}>2 $ supersymmetric AdS vacua in maximal supergravity

evidence.text: Which AdS vacua of four-dimensional maximal gauged supergravity preserve N>2 supersymmetries, which gaugings support them, and what mass spectra and AdS supermultiplets realize their partial supersymmetry breaking?

sources.title: The complete Kaluza-Klein spectra of $ \mathcal{N} $ = 1 and $ \mathcal{N} $ = 0 M-theory on AdS$_{4}$× (squashed S$^{7}$)

evidence.text: Complete the squashed-S7 Kaluza–Klein operator spectra, assign AdS4 masses and energies to the supersymmetric and skew-whiffed compactifications, and determine how boundary conditions affect possible scalar singlet marginal operators.

sources.title: More on Massive 3D Supergravity

evidence.text: Can cosmological NMG and GMG arise as genuine bosonic truncations of N = 1 supergravity, which AdS vacua are supersymmetric, and under what conditions are their linearized excitations perturbatively unitary?

sources.title: De Sitter space from warped supergravity solutions

evidence.text: What are the higher-dimensional geometries underlying noncompact gauged-supergravity de Sitter vacua and domain walls, and can their noncompact internal spaces support a lower-dimensional gravitational interpretation?

sources.title: Quantization problem in Scherk-Schwarz compactifications

evidence.text: How does lattice choice, equivalently structure-constant quantization, determine whether a flat-group Scherk–Schwarz compactification genuinely breaks supersymmetry and lifts moduli, and whether its left-invariant truncation describes the low-energy spectrum?

sources.title: Tachyonic Kaluza-Klein modes and the AdS swampland conjecture

evidence.text: Does the non-supersymmetric SO(3) × SO(3)-invariant AdS4 vacuum, stable within four-dimensional N = 8 supergravity, acquire perturbative instabilities from higher Kaluza-Klein modes after uplift to eleven dimensions?

sources.title: The conformal manifold of S-folds in string theory

evidence.text: What does the explicit type-IIB uplift reveal about the conformal manifold of 3d N=2 S-fold SCFTs, its infinite-distance limit, brane and line observables, and universal large-N partition functions?

sources.title: Dipole deformations of N=1 SYM and supergravity backgrounds with U(1) x U(1) global symmetry

evidence.text: Can torus-based deformations of wrapped-D5 holographic backgrounds modify unwanted Kaluza–Klein dynamics and improve its separation from four-dimensional SYM while retaining pure-gauge observables?

sources.title: Naturalness and UV sensitivity in Kaluza-Klein theories

evidence.text: Does compactification with Scherk–Schwarz supersymmetry breaking yield a UV-insensitive one-loop Higgs potential and mass, or does a common higher-dimensional momentum cutoff reveal additional UV sensitivity?

sources.title: Compactifications of String/M-Theory and the Swampland

evidence.text: How can internal differential-operator spectra relevant to Freund–Rubin masses be organized by symmetry? On compact Euclidean G/H, the universal Laplacian preserves irreducible G harmonic sectors, while isotropy Casimirs act on field components.

sources.title: De-Higgsing in eleven-dimensional supergravity on the squashed S $^{7}$

evidence.text: How do the Sp(1) × Sp(2) singlet modes and their AdS4 fields change between round, left-squashed and right-squashed S7 compactifications, especially through Rarita–Schwinger consistency, de-Higgsing and boundary-condition choices relevant to stability?

sources.title: Vacua of maximal gauged D = 3 supergravities

evidence.text: Which vacua occur in semisimple maximal three-dimensional gauged supergravities, what supersymmetries and fluctuation spectra do they possess, and how do their stability patterns differ from higher-dimensional examples?

sources.title: M-theory and Type IIA Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: What additional charge sources permit four-dimensional M-theory and conventional type IIA compactifications with internal four-form flux despite supergravity no-go constraints? The paper also assesses a specific massive-IIA proposal for parametrically separated AdS and Kaluza–Klein scales.

sources.title: Brane nucleation instabilities in non-AdS/non-CFT

evidence.text: Does a supersymmetry- and conformal-symmetry-breaking deformation of finite-density Klebanov–Witten theory retain low-temperature brane nucleation instabilities, and what bearing might these have on the proposed absence of disordered zero-temperature holographic phases?

sources.title: Compactifications of String/M-Theory and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can the right-squashed, nonsupersymmetric AdS4 vacuum develop a tadpole instability associated with a global singlet marginal operator (GSMO)? The thesis seeks sufficiently detailed Kaluza–Klein masses to identify elementary or composite fields that could support this mechanism.

sources.title: BPS domain walls from backreacted orientifolds

evidence.text: How does localising parallel orientifold sources change BPS domain walls obtained from smeared no-scale gauged supergravity, including flows away from the potential minimum?

sources.title: Bubbling 1/2 BPS solutions of minimal six-dimensional supergravity

evidence.text: Can retaining the torus axion remove the obstruction to a consistent four-dimensional bosonic reduction of minimal six-dimensional supergravity and produce a family of half-BPS bubbling AdS₃×S³ geometries?

sources.title: Non-SUSY DW’s in ISO(7) gauged supergravity

evidence.text: Can fake-supergravity Hamilton–Jacobi flows construct nonsupersymmetric domain walls between AdS extrema of the SU(3)-invariant ISO(7) theory, and can their properties support a conditional DW/QFT interpretation that tests the non-SUSY AdS conjecture?

sources.title: Six-dimensional supergravity on S**3 x AdS(3) and 2-D conformal field theory

evidence.text: Can representation theory determine supergravity Kaluza–Klein spectra on S³×AdS3 and explain agreement with boundary CFT chiral primaries and the additional states required by the elliptic genus? The paper also investigates less supersymmetric six- and five-dimensional examples.

sources.title: Kaluza-Klein Supergravity 2025

evidence.text: What do eleven-dimensional supergravity compactifications, especially round and squashed seven-spheres, teach about surviving supersymmetry, gauge symmetry, vacuum stability, consistent truncations and complete Kaluza–Klein spectra? This is a retrospective review with updates on spectral methods.

sources.title: New methods for old problems: vacua of maximal D = 7 supergravities

evidence.text: Can numerical optimization of embedding-tensor constraints, followed by analytical reconstruction, discover and characterize vacua across maximal seven-dimensional gauged supergravities without selecting one gauging in advance?

sources.title: $ \mathcal{N} $ = 2 CFT$_{3}$’s from $ \mathcal{N} $ = 4 gauged supergravity

evidence.text: Can deformations of four-dimensional half-maximal ISO(3) × ISO(3) gauged supergravity provide holographic evidence for interconnected N = 2 CFT3 conformal manifolds, including N = 3 and N = 4 enhancement loci?

sources.title: Scale-separated vacua with extended supersymmetry

evidence.text: Can classical massive Type IIA compactifications produce parametrically scale-separated AdS3 vacua preserving extended supersymmetry, with a consistent three-dimensional N=2 effective description?

sources.title: AdS4 flux vacua in type II superstrings and their domain-wall solutions

evidence.text: Do supersymmetric AdS4 domain walls possess attractor equations fixing horizon scalars independently of suitable asymptotic data?

sources.title: Kaluza-Klein Spectrometry from Exceptional Field Theory

evidence.text: How can exceptional field theory compute Kaluza-Klein masses and identify higher-dimensional mass eigenstates around vacua in maximal consistent truncations, including backgrounds with few or no surviving symmetries?

sources.title: M theory / heterotic duality: A Kaluza-Klein perspective

evidence.text: How much of conjectured M-theory/heterotic duality can be exhibited through classical Kaluza–Klein reductions, including scalar cosets, field couplings, charge lattices and Yang–Mills-supported branes?

sources.title: ${\mathcal{N}=(8,0)}$ AdS vacua of three-dimensional supergravity

evidence.text: Which half-maximal three-dimensional gauged supergravities admit fully supersymmetric chiral N=(8,0) AdS3 vacua for n≤8 matter multiplets, and what are their embedding tensors, gauge groups, fluctuation spectra and possible embeddings into maximal supergravity?

sources.title: Consistent subsectors of maximal supergravity and wrapped M5-branes

evidence.text: Which sufficient conditions make invariant subsectors of maximal four-dimensional gauged supergravity consistent when the invariance group lies outside the gauge group, and can a new maximal theory encompass wrapped-M5 AdS4 models and their enlarged mass spectra?

sources.title: On SUSY-breaking moduli spaces of AdS$_{7}$ vacua and 6D SCFTs

evidence.text: Can a supersymmetric massive-IIA AdS7 compactification with fixed flux and localized pole sources have continuous supersymmetry-breaking directions? The configurations have SO(3)-invariant profiles on an internal S3 and are studied in classical supergravity.

sources.title: Kaluza-Klein Spectrometry for Supergravity

evidence.text: Can exceptional field theory efficiently determine KK masses and identify the corresponding higher-dimensional fluctuations, including lower-spin sectors mixed by background fluxes, when residual isometries provide little help?

sources.title: New (maximal) gauged supergravities

evidence.text: Review how maximal classical gauged supergravities, their vacua, and their consistent higher-dimensional origins can be constructed and classified, with applications to holography.

sources.title: Shadow multiplets in AdS(4) / CFT(3) and the superHiggs mechanism: Hints of new shadow supergravities

evidence.text: Why do Freund–Rubin Kaluza–Klein spectra contain universal long multiplets with rational dimensions, and can the N=3 graviton's massive gravitino shadow be understood through N=4→N=3 super-Higgs breaking? Does its spectrum require a new supergravity formulation?

sources.title: Flux compactifications of string theory on twisted tori

evidence.text: When does a Scherk–Schwarz truncation admit a genuine compact Kaluza–Klein/string realization with a mass gap, and how do flux, gauge-symmetry breaking and duality covariance operate in that realization?

sources.title: Relative scale separation in orbifolds of S$^{2}$ and S$^{5}$

evidence.text: How much can finite sphere quotients raise the first nonzero invariant scalar-Laplacian eigenvalue, and can increasing the group order produce parametric relative scale separation for S2/SO(3) and S5/SU(3) quotients?

sources.title: Beyond Twisted Tori

evidence.text: Why did a consistent N = 4 gauged-supergravity truncation with a supersymmetric AdS4 vacuum lack a ten-dimensional interpretation using only conventional fluxes and D6/O6 sources?

sources.title: Type IIB supergravity on squashed Sasaki-Einstein manifolds

evidence.text: Can type IIB supergravity on general squashed Sasaki–Einstein five-manifolds admit a finite, nonlinear, consistent truncation retaining the massive KK states dual to the universal gauge sector?

sources.title: Hidden symmetries from extra dimensions

evidence.text: Can higher-dimensional diffeomorphisms normally broken by Kaluza–Klein truncation survive as constrained global transformations that determine lower-dimensional couplings, including R–R completions of known Type IIA NS–NS interactions?

sources.title: Cheeger bounds on spin-two fields

evidence.text: How are the explicit supersymmetric AdS4 geometries parameterized before applying the bottleneck bounds?

sources.title: On the KKLT Goldstino

evidence.text: Does a consistent truncation admitting conifold deformation introduce additional UV supersymmetry-breaking modes or modify the holographic Ward-identity diagnosis of a goldstino?

sources.title: Consistent truncations around half-maximal AdS$_{5}$ vacua of 11-dimensional supergravity

evidence.text: Which consistent truncations around eleven-dimensional AdS₅ vacua preserving 16 supercharges yield five-dimensional half-maximal gauged supergravity with vector multiplets, and what restricts their matter content and gaugings?

sources.title: Stable Nonsupersymmetric Anti–de Sitter Vacua of Massive IIA Supergravity

evidence.text: Are the seven nonsupersymmetric AdS4 vacua of maximal ISO(7) gauged supergravity stable against higher-dimensional Kaluza–Klein fluctuations after uplift to massive IIA, and how do their stability properties bear on the nonsupersymmetric AdS Swampland Conjecture?

sources.title: Supersymmetry-breaking compactifications on Riemann-flat manifolds

evidence.text: How do complete KK spectra encode spontaneous supersymmetry breaking on compact Riemann-flat spin manifolds, what supertrace identities and one-loop potentials follow, and when can the compactifications be related to Scherk–Schwarz truncations?

sources.title: Trombone gaugings of five-dimensional maximal supergravity

evidence.text: How are general five-dimensional maximal supergravities with gauged trombone scaling specified, which gaugings fit inside R+×SL(2,R)×SL(6,R), and what supersymmetric AdS vacua and spectra occur in a concrete member?

destinations.title: Can KK5 orientations and localized magnetic flux generate useful D-term interactions or supersymmetry breaking? How do the resulting source-inclusive compactifications fit into existing gauged-supergravity and generalized-geometry classifications?

Which six-dimensional cosets with left-invariant strict SU(3) structures support supersymmetric type IIA AdS4 vacua, with or without smeared sources? Can these vacua be connected by supersymmetric domain walls or interpolated to a G2-holonomy lift?

Which nonsupersymmetric AdS5×M6 compactifications on positive Kähler-Einstein six-manifolds are stable against linearized bosonic supergravity perturbations, and what do their KK spectrum, M5 nucleation channel and neutral massless scalars imply for possible instabilities?

Can left-invariant type IIA coset reductions be justified as consistent truncations, and can their four-dimensional N=2 structure constrain supersymmetric, nonsupersymmetric and de Sitter vacua, including perturbative string-loop effects?
Can universal consistent type IIB reductions on arbitrary HK4 × S1 and SE5 retain the massive breathing-mode sector, and what five-dimensional supergravity, gauging and AdS vacua result?

Which internal SU(3)-structure six-manifolds support heterotic domain walls preserving two supercharges, and do domain walls in previously constructed four-dimensional half-flat mirror compactifications lift to the corresponding ten-dimensional solutions?

Can numerically discovered AdS critical points of four-dimensional maximal gauged supergravity be characterized analytically, connected by supersymmetric holographic flows, and tested for stability against the full scalar spectrum, including modes outside small truncations?

Can a background Kaluza–Klein magnetic field produce a controlled lower-dimensional holographic IR theory, and which supersymmetric or nonsupersymmetric embeddings avoid magnetic, Coulomb-branch and other instabilities?

Can eleven-dimensional supergravity on any seven-dimensional tri-Sasakian manifold admit a universal consistent truncation retaining massive modes, and what four-dimensional gauged supergravity, AdS vacua and subtruncations result?

What is the complete linearized spectrum and perturbative stability of Freund–Rubin compactifications when a q-form individually wraps each of N internal Einstein factors, including factors with unequal flux densities?

What are the scalar potential, fermion couplings and superpotentials of the SU(3)-invariant sector of dyonic SO(8) maximal supergravity, and what do they imply for nonsupersymmetric AdS stability and BPS domain walls?

How can known de Sitter vacua of regular noncompact maximal gauged supergravity be embedded into eleven-dimensional supergravity, including vacua requiring internal flux? The paper seeks a nonlinear metric and three-form ansatz and a generalized-geometric explanation for it.

Determine the scalar Kaluza–Klein spectrum on the compact three-dimensional Heisenberg nilmanifold with general left-invariant metric, use it to assess a numerical spectral method, and construct an exploratory stable KK dark-matter candidate.
Which gaugings admit maximally supersymmetric AdS_D vacua for D≥4, and which continuous scalar deformations preserve their supersymmetry?

Which classical backgrounds preserve every supercharge of a gauged or otherwise deformed supergravity, which gaugings admit pure AdS vacua, and which continuous scalar deformations preserve their supersymmetry? The holographic motivation is to constrain conformal manifolds of dual SCFTs.

Which supersymmetric AdS4 vacua, scalar spectra and domain-wall flows arise in semisimple, dyonically gauged N = 4 supergravity, and how might they describe relevant deformations of three-dimensional N = 4 SCFTs?
Can non-supersymmetric AdS8 compactifications provide string-theoretic evidence for unitary interacting seven-dimensional CFTs, beyond the dimensions admitting superconformal theories?
Can half-maximal truncations make dyonic ISO(7) supergravity tractable while retaining its important supersymmetric vacua, and what additional gaugings and AdS extrema arise?

Which AdS5 critical points occur in five-dimensional maximal SO(6) gauged supergravity, what supersymmetry and scalar stability do they have, and how many can be captured by tractable consistent truncations?
Can associativity and completeness of Laplacian eigenmodes constrain spectra and triple overlaps on closed Einstein manifolds, thereby bounding tree-level Kaluza–Klein masses and cubic interactions?

Can Hamilton–Jacobi methods establish positive-energy protection for non-supersymmetric AdS extrema within the G₂-invariant ISO(7) truncation, construct interpolating flat domain walls, and provide a method for curved flows?
How can one vary the metric on S^7 without changing its topology? An SU(2) instanton twists an S^3 fiber over S^4; lambda scales the fiber contribution while the bundle remains S^7.
Can SO(4,4) triality generate inequivalent consistent sphere truncations of six-dimensional supergravity, exposing additional AdS3 vacua and their parameter-dependent Kaluza–Klein spectra?
What structural conditions enforce integer AdS4 scalar dimensions, and do smooth G2 geometry and localized-source corrections change the AdS3 symmetry, spectrum or decay conclusions?
How do flat deformations of type IIB S-folds encode marginal deformations holographically, change global geometry and supersymmetry, and affect stability when supersymmetry is fully broken?

Can Hamilton–Jacobi flows construct smooth, fully backreacted dS-sliced walls between supersymmetric and non-supersymmetric AdS vacua with string/M-theory uplifts, providing candidate Coleman–de Luccia bubbles beyond the thin-wall approximation?

Can continuous supersymmetry-breaking deformations of AdS3 × S3 × T4 produce perturbatively stable heterotic and type II backgrounds and a candidate nonsupersymmetric two-dimensional holographic conformal manifold? What are their KK spectra, deformation operators and tested decay channels?

How is the classical Regge growth conjecture realized by massive spin-2 Kaluza–Klein states after dimensional reduction of Einstein gravity, and what restrictions follow for their spectrum and couplings?

Which continuous deformations of AdS3×S3×T4 and AdS3×S3×S3×S1 can be constructed uniformly in heterotic and type II supergravity, what are their Kaluza–Klein spectra and perturbative stability properties, and how should their worldsheet and holographic operators be interpreted?

How do operator spectra on squashed S7 determine AdS4 masses and supersymmetry multiplets, and what do orientation reversal, boundary conditions and singletons imply for the nonsupersymmetric AdS stability question?

What do eleven-dimensional supergravity compactifications, especially round and squashed seven-spheres, teach about surviving supersymmetry, gauge symmetry, vacuum stability, consistent truncations and complete Kaluza–Klein spectra? This is a retrospective review with updates on spectral methods.
Review how maximal classical gauged supergravities, their vacua, and their consistent higher-dimensional origins can be constructed and classified, with applications to holography.

How do complete KK spectra encode spontaneous supersymmetry breaking on compact Riemann-flat spin manifolds, what supertrace identities and one-loop potentials follow, and when can the compactifications be related to Scherk–Schwarz truncations?

Which sufficient conditions make invariant subsectors of maximal four-dimensional gauged supergravity consistent when the invariance group lies outside the gauge group, and can a new maximal theory encompass wrapped-M5 AdS4 models and their enlarged mass spectra?

Can type II supergravity support non-supersymmetric AdS9 geometries warped over an interval, and what do endpoint asymptotics, Euclidean actions and holographic observables imply about their possible quantum-gravity interpretation?

Why do Freund–Rubin Kaluza–Klein spectra contain universal long multiplets with rational dimensions, and can the N=3 graviton's massive gravitino shadow be understood through N=4→N=3 super-Higgs breaking? Does its spectrum require a new supergravity formulation?

What are the higher-dimensional geometries underlying noncompact gauged-supergravity de Sitter vacua and domain walls, and can their noncompact internal spaces support a lower-dimensional gravitational interpretation?

Which small non-supersymmetric deformations of the Klebanov–Strassler confining background preserve its bosonic symmetries and regularity, and can a symmetry-preserving near-extremal branch develop a regular horizon?

Which vacua occur in semisimple maximal three-dimensional gauged supergravities, what supersymmetries and fluctuation spectra do they possess, and how do their stability patterns differ from higher-dimensional examples?

Can retaining the torus axion remove the obstruction to a consistent four-dimensional bosonic reduction of minimal six-dimensional supergravity and produce a family of half-BPS bubbling AdS₃×S³ geometries?

When does a Scherk–Schwarz truncation admit a genuine compact Kaluza–Klein/string realization with a mass gap, and how do flux, gauge-symmetry breaking and duality covariance operate in that realization?
Can torus-based deformations of wrapped-D5 holographic backgrounds modify unwanted Kaluza–Klein dynamics and improve its separation from four-dimensional SYM while retaining pure-gauge observables?

Can representation theory determine supergravity Kaluza–Klein spectra on S³×AdS3 and explain agreement with boundary CFT chiral primaries and the additional states required by the elliptic genus? The paper also investigates less supersymmetric six- and five-dimensional examples.
